segments.speaker: Alex M H Smith
segments.body: My guest today is April Dunford, and we are going to talk about positioning.

segments.speaker: Alex M H Smith
segments.body: Which is a word that has been worn almost smooth by overuse.

segments.speaker: April Dunford
segments.body: It has, and I think that is because most people treat it as a messaging exercise.

segments.speaker: April Dunford
segments.body: Positioning is not what you say. It is the context you set before you say anything at all.

segments.speaker: Alex M H Smith
segments.body: So the failure mode is a company that has a good story and the wrong frame.

segments.speaker: April Dunford
segments.body: Exactly that. And you cannot fix a frame problem with better copy, although everybody tries.
